verdict.rationale: Much of MotherDuck is reachable without the UI. SQL runs through official SDKs, the DuckDB CLI, a Postgres endpoint and the Wasm client. A remote MCP server supports read-write SQL, schema exploration, Guides and Dive generation. Secrets, DuckLake databases and usage monitoring are handled through SQL, and an openapi.json responds. However, nothing documents that every UI capability has an API equivalent. Missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity documentation, evidence of what the OpenAPI spec covers (e.g. org/user admin, share management, billing), and independent hands-on confirmation of programmatic coverage.
